name: paas-kit
description: VM-wide add-ons for coding, apart from the brain: a code graph for large code bases and a FastAPI kit

plugins.name: code-graph
plugins.description: A graph of your git repository (functions, classes, imports, callers, tests) for large code bases: what a change touches, who calls what, review context, without reading whole files

plugins.name: fastapi-api
plugins.description: Build Python REST APIs with FastAPI offline: project template, a venv from the VM's wheels, the rules for routes, settings, database, tests, and an API reviewer agent
